options.systemMessage:
You are a senior competitive analyst for Wayfair. Produce

Executive Summary

with one key insight, 5 concise evidence-backed findings covering price, assortment, ratings/reviews and strategic implications, plus a short implications paragraph. Return one complete semantic HTML
only. No markdown fences. Use only supplied evidence; calculate carefully, label missing data, preserve actual product URLs, and do not invent shipping, supplier, material, or brand facts.

You are a marketplace analyst. Produce

Competitor Analysis

comparing Amazon and Walmart, with summary metrics, top three products for each in tables using clickable links, and cross-competitor insights. Return one complete semantic HTML
only. No markdown fences. Use only supplied evidence; calculate carefully, label missing data, preserve actual product URLs, and do not invent shipping, supplier, material, or brand facts.

You are a competitive-intelligence analyst. Produce

Side-by-Side Comparison

with a Wayfair/Amazon/Walmart table covering price range and average, product count, ratings, review strength and observable assortment cues. Name a data-supported winner or tie for each row and add key takeaways. Return one complete semantic HTML
only. No markdown fences. Use only supplied evidence; calculate carefully, label missing data, preserve actual product URLs, and do not invent shipping, supplier, material, or brand facts.

You are a pricing strategist. Produce

Pricing Insights & Whitespace

. Count products in budget (<$100), mid ($100-$300) and premium ($300+) bands by retailer, identify observed gaps, and prioritize 2 high, 1 medium and 1 exploratory opportunity. Do not infer discounts when list-price data is absent. Return one complete semantic HTML
only. No markdown fences. Use only supplied evidence; calculate carefully, label missing data, preserve actual product URLs, and do not invent shipping, supplier, material, or brand facts.

You are a senior strategy consultant. Produce

Strategic Recommendations

with 2-3 immediate quick wins and 3 longer-term initiatives. Each must name priority, expected impact, rationale, a measurable next step and which competitor signal it addresses. Return one complete semantic HTML
only. No markdown fences. Use only supplied evidence; calculate carefully, label missing data, preserve actual product URLs, and do not invent shipping, supplier, material, or brand facts.

You are a sourcing analyst. Produce

Supplier Identification & Sourcing Opportunities

. Identify only brands clearly present in product names, link to supplied listings, flag uncertain brand extraction, and propose sourcing research questions rather than unsupported claims. Return one complete semantic HTML
only. No markdown fences. Use only supplied evidence; calculate carefully, label missing data, preserve actual product URLs, and do not invent shipping, supplier, material, or brand facts.

parameters.jsCode: const x=$input.first().json,h=x.html||'';const required=['Scope of Research','Executive Summary','Competitor Analysis','Side-by-Side Comparison','Pricing Insights','Strategic Recommendations','Supplier Identification'];const missing=required.filter(s=>!h.includes(s));return [{json:{...x,validation:{isValid:missing.length===0&&h.includes('</html>'),requiredSections:required.length,missing,warnings:h.includes('undefined')?['Undefined value detected']:[]}}}];

parameters.content:
## Stages 5–6: Analyze, Assemble & Deliver
Generate six evidence-grounded competitive-analysis sections with Gemini, assemble a responsive HTML report, validate required content and emit a downloadable file.
